# AL1406: Avoid 'dynamic' keyword in AOT-published code

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `AOT Testing` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1406AvoidDynamicKeywordAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

The 'dynamic' keyword requires System.Reflection.Emit at runtime to generate call sites, which is not available in Native AOT. Replace with statically typed alternatives such as interfaces, generics, or pattern matching.
